common.tagline: Find it nearby. Message the seller.

hero.headline: Kenya's social local marketplace, tuned to what you like.
hero.subheadline: Scroll real things being sold around you: cars in Rongai, phones in town, furniture down the road, fresh produce from a farmer nearby. Shopi also learns what you keep opening and saves your taste, so the feed stays local and relevant. When something feels right, message the seller and agree directly. Shopi does not take payments or commission.
hero.reassurance: Free to browse · Free to post · Buyer and seller agree directly

features.headline: Find it nearby. Message the seller. Agree between yourselves.

scroll.title: Discovery beats typing and hoping
scroll.body: Search works when you already know the exact words. Shopi is for the other moments too: you scroll a local feed and come across a sofa, a clean phone, a car, a pair of shoes, or produce you were not planning to search for.

message.title: The deal stays between buyer and seller
message.body: There is no cart, checkout, escrow or Shopi agent holding money. Tap to chat, ask for more photos, negotiate, choose where to meet or how to deliver, and close the deal your way.

local.title: Nearby sellers show up first
local.body: A buyer in Meru should not start with random listings from far away. Shopi uses location to bring nearby posts forward, while still letting good listings travel across Kenya when they match what people like.

ai.title: Your feed gets more relevant over time
ai.body: Shopi looks at what you open, save and message, then surfaces more of that kind of thing. Keep clicking land listings and you will see more plots. Spend time on TVs, phones or fashion, and the feed adjusts with you.

tiktok.title: Feels social, works like classifieds
tiktok.body: Posts are quick to watch and easy to share, but every item has marketplace context: price, location, seller, photos or video, and a direct path to message.

free.title: Free to list. Free to browse.
free.body: Shopi is here to connect people, not to sit inside the transaction. Sellers keep their price, buyers talk directly, and both sides decide what happens next.

howItWorks.headline: A local deal without the long route.

1.title: Open the feed
1.body: Start with the feed. Cars, phones, fashion, furniture, farm produce, livestock and home items appear as real posts from real sellers.

2.title: See what is nearby
2.body: Location helps surface sellers around you first, then your interests help sort what rises to the top, so the feed stays practical and relevant.

3.title: Message the seller
3.body: Ask if it is available, request details, negotiate, and agree on pickup or delivery. The conversation is direct.

4.title: Agree outside checkout
4.body: Shopi does not process payments or take a cut. Buyer and seller decide price, payment, meeting point and delivery between themselves.

audience.headline: For the people already buying and selling in Kenya every day.

buyers.title: Find useful things before you think to search.
buyers.body: Maybe you came for a phone and ended up spotting a sofa, a good mitumba bale, a used car, or fresh produce nearby. Shopi keeps discovery open, uses your interests to tune the feed, then lets you message the seller when something makes sense.

sellers.title: Your phone can put the item in front of nearby buyers.
sellers.body: Record what you are selling, add the price and location, and post. Buyers discover it in the feed and message you directly. No website, no checkout setup, no commission removed from your sale.

testimonials.headline: Made for everyday Kenyan buying and selling.

download.headline: The next good find may be a few scrolls away.
download.body: Open the feed and see what people near you are selling today. No checkout, no commission, no pressure to create an account before you start browsing.

footer.tagline: Kenya's local marketplace feed. Discover it, message the seller, agree directly.
